text:
RackPeek is a self-hosted CLI and web app for documenting home labs and small IT environments. Track hardware, systems, services, and connections in a portable YAML inventory. Use the CLI or web app to manage it, discover existing infrastructure, and export data for tools such as Ansible.

 Quick start

Open RackPeek stores its inventory in config.yaml inside the volume. For bind mounts, the host directory must be writable by container user 1654 ; add :Z on SELinux systems.

 Mobile app

The iOS and Android app supports local inventory editing and syncs with a RackPeek server when connected. The app is in early access; join the Discord for updates and testing information.

install.title: Quick start
install.html:
Run RackPeek with a persistent Docker volume:

docker volume create rackpeek-config
docker run -d \
  --name rackpeek \
  -p 8080:8080 \
  -v rackpeek-config:/app/config \
  aptacode/rackpeek:latest

Open http://localhost:8080. RackPeek stores its inventory in config.yaml inside the volume. For bind mounts, the host directory must be writable by container user 1654; add :Z on SELinux systems.
